mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear night near Badger Ridge Middle School with a current temperature of 66 degrees. We are under a waning crescent moon, and the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 61 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city updates, construction on Highway M moves into phase two this week, bringing traffic shifts for the next few weeks. Additionally, a new public art piece, the Tai Chi Animal Frolics tree, is now on display at Century School Park.
There is plenty to do in Verona, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at trivia nights at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

The Verona Police Department reported that a 34-year-old woman was arrested on Friday, September 4, following an investigation into an inappropriate relationship with a student that took place on Sunday, August 30.

The Culver's of Verona is now closed for the evening. Today's featured flavor was Georgia Peach, but be sure to stop by tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM to enjoy the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day.
